model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the changes in the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. 
The X-axis is labeled "Layer" and represents the layer number, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, marked at intervals of 5. 
The Y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and represents the sparsity ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2.

The graph features three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average of 0.03, an orange dotted line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average of 0.44, and a green dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average of 0.33. 
The blue line starts at approximately 0.15 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 at layer 22. 
The orange line begins at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.1 at layer 16, and then fluctuates between 0.1 and 0.4 until layer 22. 
The green line starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.1 at layer 13, and then remains relatively stable until layer 22.

Overall, the graph provides a visual representation of how the sparsity ratio changes across different layers for the three scenarios.
model_annotations.Chinese: The chart displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across various layers, given a threshold of $1e-2$. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22 with an interval of approximately 2.5 between each labeled tick mark. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0 with an interval of 0.2 between each labeled tick mark. Three distinct lines are plotted on the graph: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate", an orange dotted line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate", and a green dash-dot line representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.17 at layer 0.4 and decreases to 0.02 by layer 22. The orange dotted line begins at 1.0 at layer 0 and decreases to 0.06 by layer 22, with a notable fluctuation between layers 13 and 22. The green dash-dot line also starts at 1.0 at layer 0 and declines to 0.06 by layer 22, exhibiting a similar downward trend to the orange line but with a more pronounced decrease between layers 2 and 8.
